g.text: Figure 2. GO:BP enrichment and gene-term membership across the conserved Arabidopsis drought signature

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #455a64

g.text: Enrichment was performed with g:Profiler using the custom common tested-gene background and FDR correction (threshold = 0.05). In panels A-C, dot size represents the number of query genes intersecting each GO:BP term. In panel D, square size represents -log10(FDR-adjusted p-value), circle size represents gene

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #455a64

g.text: degree among the selected terms, and orange circles highlight genes with degree >= 8 (a descriptive visual threshold). Edges represent gene-to-GO-term annotation membership, not gene-gene interactions. Memberships were reconstructed from saved g:Profiler intersections.
